Services

Bow to stern.

Regular upkeep, deep restoration and long-lasting protection, all with professional products used every day by the team.

01

Wash Plans

02

Full Detail with Wax

03

Ceramic Coating

Protection for 12 to 18 months, easier cleaning and more gloss.

04

Scratch and hologram removal, heavy oxidation removal, wet sanding, buffing and polishing.

Teak Maintenance

Teak cleaning and sealer application, best done 4 times a year.

Keeps your cabin interior clean.
